facts.fact: The DHIS2 Community post says the Ministry of Health deployed a national DHIS2 system across the country's health system, with data flowing from remote zones and sub-zones to central analysis.
The WHO UHC Partnership record lists an Eritrea activity supporting sector digitization and DHIS-2 roll out, completed in 2018 at 70 percent implementation.

note: Lists Eritrea's health plan with no standalone digital instrument; names no health information system.
The app is a medicines-list reference tool, not facility reporting to the ministry.
